sentiment.reason_it: Il VIX a 16.04 (-0.19%) indica un mercato difensivo ma non in panico; il S&P 500 è sceso del 0.17% a 7,670.84, segnale di lieve pressione al ribasso. Il DXY resta stabile a 101.38, il Brent è in forte calo (-6.13%) e il TLT 20Y è in ribasso (-0.50%). Con il VIX sotto 18 e l'S&P negativo, il punteggio di risk_off è limitato a 3, mantenendo un sentiment neutro.
sentiment.reason_en: The VIX at 16.04 (-0.19%) signals a defensive but not panicky market; the S&P 500 slipped 0.17% to 7,670.84, showing slight downside pressure. The DXY is flat at 101.38, Brent has dropped sharply (-6.13%) and the 20Y TLT fell (-0.50%). With VIX below 18 and a negative S&P, the risk_off score caps at 3, resulting in a neutral market sentiment.

Commodities: Brent -6.13% spinge il sentiment bearish, mentre l'oro a $4,210.70 (+0.74%) resta in zona mista. Il DXY stabile a 101.38 non sostiene un risk‑off marcato.
market_impact_summary.en: Equities: S&P 500 -0.17% and STOXX 600 -0.05% reflect modest equity weakness. Fixed Income: 20Y TLT -0.50% and US 10Y yield at 5.25% (+0.29%) indicate upward pressure on rates. Commodities: Brent -6.13% drives a bearish bias, while gold at $4,210.70 (+0.74%) stays mixed. A flat DXY at 101.38 does not reinforce a strong risk‑off stance.

articles.title: The Manhattan Project Mindset: How Nuclear Analogies Are Steering AI Policy Off Course
articles.snippet: Analogies for artificial intelligence abound. In recent years, analysts have likened the development of AI to the advent of electricity, the Industrial Revolution, contact with extraterrestrials, and at least fifty other things. One analogy, however, appears to have won out over the rest: AI is like nuclear weapons.This comparison is now ubiquitous in government rhetoric, policy debates, and media accounts about AI. The risks of advanced AI are equated with the existential risk posed by nuclear weapons. There are several references to AI development as a modern-day Manhattan Project.
